author: GitHub
description:
Switching between pull requests and issues usually means losing context and wasting time. In this demo, we show how the new GitHub Copilot app keeps all your work in one place. By using isolated work trees, you can manage multiple active branches without ever stashing changes. Watch as we use agent merge to handle slow CI and merge branches automatically. Keep your momentum going and ship code faster.

#GitHubCopilot #MicrosoftBuild #GitHub
